evidence.title: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
evidence.claim: The xylene wipe of the agitator was added to the procedure in 1998 via CR-1998-009.
evidence.quote: Added xylene wipe of agitator (CR-1998-009). Lid left open overnight.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-1998-009
evidence.claim: In 1998, the xylene wipe was introduced because acetone failed to dissolve chlorinated rubber paint residues from the CR-55 line, causing batch contamination.
evidence.quote: residues of the chlorinated rubber paints (CR-55 line) are not dissolved by acetone and contaminate the next batch.

evidence.title: Product portfolio memo PM-2009-002
evidence.claim: The chlorinated rubber range, including CR-55, was discontinued in 2009 because the resin was unavailable from the supplier.
evidence.quote: The chlorinated rubber range (CR-55 swimming-pool and road-marking paints) is discontinued: the chlorinated rubber resin is no longer available

evidence.title: EHS memo - xylene exposure reduction
evidence.claim: As of 2021, xylene is used exclusively for the agitator wipe in SOP-07.
evidence.quote: Xylene is now used at the plant only for the agitator wipe in SOP-07

evidence.title: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
evidence.claim: The xylene wipe of the agitator was still part of the SOP-07 cleaning procedure in 2015.
evidence.quote: Wipe agitator shaft and blades with xylene-soaked rag.
